params.prompt: Bold, simple, instantly readable mobile app ad visual, 4:5 vertical. Solid saturated flat background with subtle radial glow, nothing else in the scene. The hero group sits in the center (35%-82% height). Upper 30% of frame completely empty, bottom 15% completely empty. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people except the mascot, no money. Clean premium 3D render. Include the cute 3D mascot from the reference image (Meri: big round fluffy orange petal-shaped hair like a flower, round peach face with rosy cheeks, red sweater with white letter M), drawn SMALL (about 25% of the hero group height) as a supporting accent, not the main subject. Hero object: a glossy 3D wallet-style card holder with four card slots; three slots hold colorful insurance cards (blue, green, purple, no text), one slot is empty and glows red inside, with a big red notification badge with exclamation mark symbol above that empty slot. Meri peeks out from behind the card holder holding a magnifying glass, curious face. Background: vivid cobalt blue.
